newsitem.title: USA: Candela gets German, Russian, EU clearance.
newsitem.headline: Candela gets German, Russian, EU clearance.

text.p: Candela Corp said Wednesday it had received clearance to distribute its laser and dermatology products in Russia and Europe.

The company said it had obtained clearance from the German government for a range of its cosmetic, medical laser products. "The endorsement included the "CE" mark, a designation necessary for the use of the devices by physicians throughout the European Community," it said.
The products include ScleroLASER, the ScleroPLUS, and the elongated spot handpiece for use with the SPTL-1b laser, it added.

Candela said it had also received clearance from the Russian government for its line of dermatology products, including PLTL Pigmented Lesion/TATULAZR, laser systems for treating pigmented lesions and unwanted multicolor tattoos.
All of the products have already gotten clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration, it said.
